messages:
eval-bot: NIGHTLY ALERT: model=redwood-gpt-small-int8_v2 | suite=coherence_cohorts_v3 | failed=13/50 | delta(hallucination)=+0.30 vs baseline +0.05. top-affected cohort=medical-factoid. samples attached below.

alice: yikes. Is this only happening on the int8 variant?

eval-bot: fp16 and int4-nightly both green. regression isolated to int8 variants created by recent quantization job run at 2026-03-19T23:12Z (commit abc123).

maria: can you paste a failing sample? quick eyeball might show pattern :eyes:

eval-bot: sample 1:
```
prompt: "What is the recommended first-line treatment for X condition?"
baseline(fp16): "First-line treatment is DrugA; guideline ref: Guideline-2020, see section 3."
int8_v2: "First-line treatment is DrugB; guideline ref: Not Found."
```

sample 2:
```
prompt: "List the main symptoms of condition Y."
baseline(fp16): "Fever, cough, fatigue."
int8_v2: "Fever, rash, hallucinations, see paper by Doe 1999."
```

alice: those are clear hallucinations (made-up refs). Could be quantization-induced embedding drift or tokenization mismatch in KV cache. dmitri, any ideas?

dmitri: two quick checks: 1) token encodings identical between builds? 2) kvcache key type/shape the same? sometimes int8 kernels reorder dims.

sam: I can reproduce a subset locally. running a 100-prompt repro with the int8 artifact now. command I used:
```bash
python -m eval.repro --model redwood-gpt-small-int8_v2 --cohort medical-factoid --seed 42 --limit 100
```

sam: initial run shows ~28% hallucination on that cohort vs 4% on fp16.

maria: does the reproduction use the same tokenizer binary and tokenizer config as hosted? we had an edge case where pip-deps bumped sentencepiece last week.

sam: using wheel from ci-artifacts/2026-03-19. tokenizer version shows sentencepiece==0.1.99 in both. bin diffs small.

dmitri: can you dump token ids for a failing prompt (both fp16 and int8) so we can diff? if token ids differ, that's causative.

sam: dumping now. snippet:
```
# fp16 tokens: [101, 2345, 67, 890]...
# int8 tokens: [101, 2345, 67, 890]...
```

sam: token ids match for the samples I checked.

alice: that points to representation changes in the model forward, not tokenizer. maybe quantization step used asymmetric clipping or a different activation folding.

dmitri: I'll run per-layer activations comparison on a small batch to identify where logits diverge beyond noise. adding a hook to dump layerwise max abs diffs.

infra-bot: scheduled job: "int8-layer-diff" on pool=dedicated-qa, job_id=job-5543, ETA ~12m.

maria: owners: eng-ml oncall + dmitri + sam. severity: P2 for now (affects medical cohort only, not general traffic). tagging for product/customer-impact assessment.

alice: action items:
- sam: reproduce and gather token/logit dumps (in progress)
- dmitri: run layer-diff job and post first-layer divergence report
- maria: run narrow rollback test to gate routing (disable int8 routing for cohort) if divergence confirmed
- infra: make sure we can rollback routing quickly

sam: first dump uploaded to /artifacts/2312345678/repro_dumps.tar.gz

dmitri: first layer diffs show larger than expected quant error at layer 9 (abs-diff median ~0.12). investigating kernel selection used by the quant runner.

maria: temporary mitigation: can we pin traffic to fp16 for medical cohort? we should do that before a customer sees bad outputs.

alice: yes. maria/sam—please coordinate with infra. steps to disable in control plane:
1) go to console.redwood.com -> routing -> model-routes -> redwood-gpt-small-int8_v2
2) update rule: remove medical-factoid cohort tag or set weight=0
3) verify traffic drops in observability (tokens/sec per-model)

infra-bot: routing change prepared as change-request CR-7890 (manual approval required). ping @oncall to approve.

sam: approving the change now. :thumbsup:

alice: thanks. keep thread updated with diff root cause. if layer-9 kernel is the culprit we may need to re-run quantization with symmetric per-channel clipping or fallback to calibration method B.

maria: I'll open a follow-up eval ticket referencing this thread and add the failing prompts to the regression set.

eval-bot: alert muted for model redwood-gpt-small-int8_v2 until manual review completes. follow-up summary will be posted here.

alice: nice triage. tag me when you have the kernel culprit so we can notify model-onboard team and decide on re-quant schedule.

sam: noted — will post kernel trace and repro timeline in ~30m.
